name: What does the trim repair process involve from start to finish?

mainEntity.name: What does the trim repair process involve from start to finish?

acceptedAnswer.text: Interior trim repair begins with an on-site evaluation of the wood profile, fastening points, and surrounding surfaces. The technician removes any loose splintered wood, cleans out deteriorated caulk, and re-secures loose pieces using pneumatic trim nails driven directly into studs. Next, voids and seams are filled with high-grade wood filler or two-part epoxy, followed by progressive sanding to achieve a flush profile. Finally, the contractor applies primer to bare spots, seals the top seams with flexible caulk, and applies matching interior paint so the repair is virtually invisible against the wall.
acceptedAnswer.description: The process includes securing loose trim, removing damaged material, filling gouges, sanding flush, caulking open seams, and priming and painting to blend with your walls.
